legal.privacyIntro: Urugero rw'ibanga rusobanura amakuru Wizzo Market ikusanya, impamvu tuyakusanya n'ubushobozi ufite. Rukoreshwa kuri porogaramu n'urubuga rwa Wizzo Market.
legal.privacySection1Body1: Iyo ufungura konte, utanga amazina yawe, aderesi ya imeyili na numero ya telefoni. Iyo ukohereza amabuyoboze, tubika inyandiko z'aderesi na byu byaguze.
legal.privacySection1Body2: Tukurikirana amakuru yo muri porogaramu nka urutonde rw'ibikunzwe, ubutumwa, ibitekerezo n'ubuishoboze bwo kumenyeshwa kugira ngo ibikorwa bikore nk'uko bikenewe.
legal.privacySection2Body1: Amakuru yawe akoreshwa mu gucunga konte yawe, kohereza amabuyoboze, kwishyura, kurinda isoko no kuguma ukumenyesheje ibikorwa byawe.
legal.privacySection2Body2: Hamwe n'uburemure bwawe, twohereza amakuru y'uburangije n'amahirwe. Urashobora kuyahagarika igihe cyose mu Igenamiterere ry'Amamenyesha ryo muri konte yawe.
legal.privacySection3Body1: Abagurisha babona amakuru yagombaga gusohoza ubuyoboze bwawe, nka aderesi yo kugezaho na numero ya telefoni. Amakuru y'ubwishyu agama kuri serivise yawe ya mobile money cyangwa banki.
legal.privacySection4Body1: Urashobora kwivugurura mu porofile no mu aderesi, guhindura imeyili cyangwa ijambo ry'ibanga, no kugenzura amamenyesha ku ibikorwa bya konte.
legal.privacySection4Body2: Urashobora gusaba gukuraho konte yawe n'amakuru yawe wohereza imeyili kuri {email}. Tubikoze mu minsi 30.
legal.privacySection5Body1: Amabanga abikwa ku buryo bwo hashing no guhana amakuru byarindwa mu nzira. Kwinjira ku konto bisaba amakuru yawe.
legal.privacySection5Body2: Dukomeza kubika inyandiko igihe konte yawe ikiriho kandi mu gihe byasabwa n'amategeko cyangwa mu gukemura amakimbirane.
legal.termsIntro: Murakaza neza kuri Wizzo Market. Aya mategeko ya serivisi agenga uko ukoresha porogaramu n'urubuga rwa Wizzo Market. Nyamuneka uyasome mbere yo gukoresha porogaramu.
legal.termsSection1Body1: Wizzo Market ihuza abaguzi n'abagurisha muri Afrika. Mu gukoresha porogaramu, wemera gukora mu kuri, gushyiraho gusa ibintu ufite by'ukuri, kandi ntuzigere ushukana cyangwa uburizya undi ukoresha.
legal.termsSection1Body2: Ugomba kuba byibura imyaka 18 kugira ngo ufungure konte, cyangwa ugire umubyeyi cyangwa umurinzi wemera aya mategeko mu izina ryawe.
legal.termsSection2Body1: Iyo utanze ubuyoboze, wiyemeza kubwishyura ukoresheje uburyo bwemewe: mobile money, kohereza kuri banki, ikarita, cyangwa kwishyura igihe utanze iyo biraboneka.
legal.termsSection2Body2: Ibikorwa bya Mobile Money bishyirwa mu bikorwa na serivise zawe kandi bigengwa n'amafaranga, impande n'amategeko byazo. Ntuzigere wohereza amafaranga mbere yo kunyuzwa n'ubuyoboze bwawe.
legal.termsSection2Body3: Igihe cyo kohereza bitewe n'umucuruzi n'aho uri. Urashobora gukurikirana amabuyoboze kuri porogaramu y'Amabuyoboze Yanjye no kuvugana n'umucuruzi mu iganiro rikorerwa muri porogaramu.
legal.termsSection3Body1: Niba ubuyoboze bgageze bwangijwe, bukabije cyangwa butari nk'uko bwasobanuwe, saba kugarura buvatse ku ipaji y'ubuyoboze mu minsi 7 nyuma yo kukoherezwa.
legal.termsSection3Body2: Abafaranga basubizwa ku buryo bumwe bwo kwishyura wakoresheje, igihe umucuruzi amaze kwemeza kugarura. Amabuyoboze yishyujwe ku geza aherekezwa basubizwa kuri Waleti ya Wizzo.
legal.termsSection4Body1: Ushinzwe gukomeza amakuru yawe yo kwinjira. Umenyeshe ibikorwa bishidikanywa {email}.
legal.termsSection4Body2: Wizzo ishobora guhagarika konte zicuza aya mategeko, zishaka kwiburizya abandi, cyangwa zikoresha porogaramu mu bikorwa bizirirwa.
legal.termsSection5Body1: Wizzo ni urubuga rw'isoko muroroshya ibikorwa hagati y'abaguzi n'abagurisha. Ntabwo turuhande rwa buri igurisha kandi ntidushyizweho ububasha ku bicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi z'umucuruzi kurenza ibisobanuwe n'aya mategeko.
legal.termsSection5Body2: Ku rwego rwuzuye rwemewe n'amategeko, ububasha bwose bwa Wizzo bukurirwa ku mafaranga wabyishyuye by'ukuri mu bikorwa bibazwe.
